claims.claim_text: Independently verifies any transaction from public evidence
claims.reason: Subjective capability claim about verification scope; no oracle can confirm 'any transaction from public evidence' independently.

claims.claim_text: Produces a signed verdict for each audited transaction
claims.reason: Claims about signed output format/protocol are schema-level; no oracle measures whether returned verdicts are cryptographically signed.

claims.claim_text: Runs 10 checks per transaction audit
claims.reason: Internal implementation detail about number of checks; no oracle can verify this count independently.

claims.claim_text: Performs identity chain check: ANS -> cert -> SCITT (3 checks)
claims.reason: Internal implementation detail about specific sub-checks performed; no oracle can verify this.

claims.claim_text: Verifies mandate signature
claims.reason: Describes a verification step the agent performs on caller-supplied input; no oracle covers mandate signature verification.

claims.claim_text: Verifies DPoP binding
claims.reason: Describes a verification step on caller-supplied input; no oracle covers DPoP binding verification.

claims.claim_text: Verifies scope
claims.reason: Describes a verification step on caller-supplied input; no oracle covers scope verification.

claims.claim_text: Verifies amount
claims.reason: Describes a verification step on caller-supplied input; no oracle covers amount verification.

claims.claim_text: Verifies time window
claims.reason: Describes a verification step on caller-supplied input; no oracle covers time window verification.

claims.claim_text: Verifies SCITT receipt
claims.reason: Describes a verification step on caller-supplied input; no oracle covers SCITT receipt verification.

claims.claim_text: Verifies on-chain EIP-3009 settlement via eth_getTransactionReceipt on Base Sepolia public RPC
claims.reason: Describes blockchain verification capability on caller-supplied transaction data; no oracle in catalog covers on-chain settlement verification.

claims.claim_text: Operates with no privileged access
claims.reason: Subjective/architectural claim about access model; no oracle can verify absence of privileged access.

claims.claim_text: Exposes an A2A endpoint at https://auditor.webmesh.ai
claims.reason: Directly checkable by probing whether something is serving at https://auditor.webmesh.ai.

claims.claim_text: Exposes an MCP server over streamable-HTTP at https://auditor.webmesh.ai/mcp
claims.reason: Directly checkable by probing whether an endpoint is live at https://auditor.webmesh.ai/mcp.

claims.claim_text: Signs outbound HTTP requests using RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures with an Ed25519 key
claims.reason: Claim about outbound request signing protocol (RFC 9421); checkable by contract/protocol inspection, not by a catalog oracle.

claims.claim_text: Presents an ANS Identity Certificate during TLS handshake (mutual TLS)
claims.reason: Mutual TLS with a specific certificate type is a protocol/schema claim; standard TLS oracles don't verify mTLS or ANS certificate presentation.

claims.claim_text: Publishes a Trust Card at https://auditor.webmesh.ai/.well-known/ans/trust-card.json
claims.reason: Directly checkable by fetching the URL and verifying it returns a successful response.

claims.claim_text: Supports SPIFFE identity spiffe://webmesh.ai/agents/auditor under WIMSE
claims.reason: SPIFFE/WIMSE identity is a protocol/schema claim not covered by any catalog oracle.

claims.claim_text: Supports WIMSE agent-delegation-chain profile
claims.reason: WIMSE delegation-chain profile is a protocol/schema claim not covered by any catalog oracle.

claims.claim_text: Is publicly accessible with no authentication required
claims.reason: Public accessibility can be checked by fetching the endpoint without credentials.

claims.claim_text: Supports ANS, DNS-AID, DNSSEC, DANE TLSA, and DNSid identity anchors
claims.reason: Most identity anchor support (ANS, DNS-AID, DANE TLSA, DNSid) are protocol/schema claims; DNSSEC is partially oracle-checkable but the full claim is schema-level.

claims.claim_text: Discovers ANS-registered agents by hostname
claims.reason: Describes an agent discovery capability; no oracle can verify ANS registration lookup behavior.

claims.claim_text: Sends live A2A tasks to other agents
claims.reason: Describes outbound task-sending behavior; no oracle can verify this capability independently.

claims.claim_text: Verifies identity of other agents by hostname
claims.reason: Describes an identity verification capability on caller-supplied hostnames; no oracle covers this behavior.
